easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Omni-Changeling
description:
Cast Omni-Changeling by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Omni-Changeling into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Omni-Changeling's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Omni-Changeling's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Omni-Changeling's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.
